heroPosterAlt: Two participants holding Casmara certificates beside a brand representative, the logo on the screen behind them
statement: You make the event happen. I make sure people talk about it. Nobody notices me in the room, and the first edited photos arrive the same evening. Brands get the same rule: yours already looks good — now we prove it. Photos, Reels and content, once or every month.
ctaTitle: Your best frame is still ahead.
ctaText: Tell me what, where and when. Within one working day I’ll tell you if the date is free — and what I suggest.
statementTitle: The evening ends. The photos don’t.
runOfShowTitle: A conference day, hour by hour

runOfShow.title: Before the first guest
runOfShow.text: The empty room, the stage, every sponsor banner. In full light, before anyone walks in.

runOfShow.title: Registration
runOfShow.text: Badges, coffee, first handshakes. Candid frames that prove the room was full.

runOfShow.title: Opening keynote
runOfShow.text: From the foot of the stage: the speaker’s best gestures and the room reacting. No flash, no distraction.

runOfShow.title: Panel discussion
runOfShow.text: Every panellist, every question from the floor, and wide frames that show the scale.

runOfShow.title: Workshops
runOfShow.text: Breakout rooms and group work: hands, flip charts, people thinking out loud.

runOfShow.title: Closing and group photo
runOfShow.text: The final applause, all the speakers together. The group photo is planned in advance: two minutes, done.

runOfShow.title: First photos in your inbox
runOfShow.text: An edited selection for press and social media. The same evening.
